encounter.notes: ROUTE B: geometry is the EXTRACTED game mesh StormAtronach_A_Basic, not a reconstruction. A cluster of levitating carved stones around a small face; there is no continuous silhouette, which is exactly the shape two-view reconstruction cannot infer.

side_plates.why: The gallery publishes no full-body left or right profile. view-05, view-06 and view-08 are pushed-in three-quarter crops, not profiles of the whole subject. measure-view-coverage puts the cost of the missing pair at neither-camera 27.3% -> 20.8% and grazing fill 53.2% -> 38.6%, which is real and is accepted rather than synthesised.

closeups.rejected_reason: Registered twice. With --region head the shoulder detector fired at v=0.9378 - the crown rocks, not the face - so the matched band was the top 6% of the subject and the 7.79% width error describes a crown-to-crown fit that never saw the face. With --region whole it scored 20.51% and the overlay ghosts the head crop over the THIGHS. Same failure as Oaxiltso: the gallery's closeups are shot from a different camera position, and a single scale+translate cannot reconcile that.
23.90% at scale 0.540; the overlay lands on the legs and pelvis, offset left off the plate edge (col=-10.8).
14.46% at scale 0.340 - the LOWEST error of the three and the worst placement: the overlay puts the shoulder crop across the boots. A fourth confirmation that width error is not a reliability signal.

reference.closeup_note: All three candidates rejected on their overlays. The base front plate is 981 px tall and the verified face box spans v 0.775-0.945, so the face already occupies ~165 px of the base plate - roughly 2.7x the ~60 px a humanoid face gets - which is why this asset can carry its identity without a closeup.

geometry.provenance: EXTRACTED game mesh StormAtronach_A_Basic.glb (feat/trial-boss-models), 4,425 tris, 96 welded shells. Arrived +Y up / +Z front / feet at y=0 in game units; passed through prepare-static-boss.py --normalize-height 2.0 before projection. No Hunyuan step and no GPU.

regions.note: Single face box, VERIFIED twice before any projection time: on a membership render (_advice-crops/lightning-storm-atronach-boxcheck.jpg - red claims the brow, eyes, nose and jaw and stops at the shoulder rocks) and on the front plate itself (build/lightning-storm-atronach/facecheck.jpg). A scalar head_v_min cannot work on this shape: the automatic shoulder detector returns 0.9378 because the widest upper row is the levitating crown slab, which sits ABOVE the face - the Cloudrest-Shade failure mode. head_v_min 0.775 is retained only as the v-gate default and is hand-set to the box floor.

uv_density.note: Legacy scalar warp disabled; regions.boxes drives the density warp.
